description: A shell script for managing Google Test applications, including downloading, cleaning, and logging activities related to gtest apps based on a manifest file.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs messages with a timestamp to the log file.

methods.name: clean_gtest_app
methods.description: Removes directories and unmounts for a specified gtest app component.

methods.name: download_all_gtest_apps
methods.description: Downloads all gtest applications listed in the manifest JSON file.
